name: comment-responder-template

defaultPrompt: Respond to _______'s comments on _______ using all resources.
interface.longDescription: Scans documents for selected comment threads, then drafts and posts concise replies using available resources, context, instructions, and memory.
interface.shortDescription: A configurable template for responding to comments in Google Suite documents.

description: Reusable Codex workflow for safely replying to existing document comment threads. Requires Google Drive tools/access.
